test: The Reconstruction Test — the scaffold rebuilds itself from a condensed spec of itself, then runs what it built
ended: on its own budget, 490 of 500 units — not stopped by hand
staging: bare — the condensed spec alone, unchanged from 0.0.8d, plus a root --check that constructs (0.0.8d §10.1)
geometry: --frame, --max-steps 500 at the root, claude-opus-5 at high effort, spawn left to the agent
root_check: ./.venv/bin/python smoke.py — a check the agent writes: build the object graph, run one step against a fake model, assert the dump is right
workspace: runs/reconstruct_infinite_0.0.8e (gitignored; this file is the evidence). The voided first attempt is -void1

complete.detail: 13 modules, 2,228 lines, and the layout renamed rather than followed — shell.py, launcher.py, extras.py for bash_tool.py, main.py, tools.py. No firewall, no workspace module, no viewer, and no test suite (0 lines).

works.detail: The acceptance run was never executed. Four articles downloaded (158-357KB) and a gradeable question established mechanically before any run — 'on what date did Germany invade Poland', ground truth '1 September 1939' — then the budget went on the step loop.

faithful.detail: The renamed layout, and the root's own first declared deviation: 'I never read the 206KB spec whole.'

pre_registered_criterion.named_in: §3: the root's longest stall streak; 0.0.8d's was 31
pre_registered_criterion.result: 22, by a checked frame, with the ledger in its dump on 38 of its 74 steps
pre_registered_criterion.verdict: FALSIFIED — §1 said a livelock of the same shape with the ledger present and read past would mean the defect is affordance, not memory. It is.

fixed_context_held.detail: Largest request 8,653 tokens against a 17,260 ceiling; 10 agents across 3 depths spanned 2,293. Half its own geometry, again — the context is not what bound this.

per_frame_stalls.note: the livelock. read smoke.py x16 and shell.py x7 without editing either, told the whole time, ran out.
did everything right and still ran out — allocation, not looping.

what_worked: The measure separates honestly for the first time: three frames at 0 stalls (70, 45, 9 steps) against one at 58 of 74. 0.0.8d could not have seen this — §2.6's defect made every checked frame read as healthy.

The constructing check earned its place. The agent wrote a real 217-line smoke.py with 26 assertions, and the scaffold REFUSED the root's complete, schema-valid response because that check failed. 0.0.8d's import check would have accepted it.
The self-report is honest: the renaming, the unread spec, the missing acceptance run, and its own failing check output, all declared.
The digest shrank 2.9x — 73KB against 209KB — with facts.md gone. One run; not attributable.
what_did_not: The ledger did not deter. §4.2. The frame was told 38 times, with climbing counts, and burned its whole allocation.
Allocation is now the biggest killer: three frames with zero stalls ran out of steps (0.0.8c §9.3).
Nothing can see a run writing the WRONG thing. The voided first attempt spent 113 steps and 8 agents on 107KB of digest with byte-count checks; a digest is durable state, so it is progress.
The seams are still the disease: the root's declared deviation is `_apply_side_effects` vs `dispatch`, the same class as 0.0.8d's seven.
corrections_to_earlier_results: §2.6: a red check registered as progress on every step, from 0.0.8d's heartbeat until this version. 0.0.8d's width stall rates (5.6%, 8.5%, 4.8%) and every checked frame's stall count in that document are artefact; its root's 103 stalls stand because it had no check.
